title: Identify states of water and boiling point
description: Identify the boiling point of water and investigate evaporation from open and closed containers.

title: Identify human digestive and circulatory systems
description: Identify major human organs including the stomach, intestines, heart, and lungs, describing their primary functions.

title: Describe the water cycle and precipitation processes
description: Describe the stages of the water cycle including evaporation, transpiration, condensation, and precipitation.

title: Investigate friction, air resistance and gravity
description: Investigate how friction, air resistance, and gravity act upon moving bodies in terrestrial environments.

title: Distinguish between reversible and irreversible chemical changes
description: Distinguish between physical dissolving/freezing and irreversible reactions that produce new substances such as gas.
